taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-08 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 218.1 | 18.02 | 18.02
2 | 105.0 | 1.05 | 19.07
3 | 60.0 | 1.04 | 20.11
4 | 317.3 | 0.57 | 20.68
5 | 1743.2 | 5.17 | 25.85
6 | 2231.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-08
Curve type: QHA
Aquifer depth: 19.07 m – 20.11 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity zone (≈60 Ω·m) between 19.1 m and 20.1 m depth as the probable saturated/aquiferous horizon; set casing through the overlying layers and screen across this interval, while confirming lithology with drill cuttings since the layer is thin (~1 m) and may pinch out laterally.
